build_HiRadixCache: build a hierarchical radix cache instance with MHA, MLA, or NSA model support and optional storage backend
attach_storage_backend: attach a storage backend at runtime to enable prefetch and backup paths for the hierarchical cache
evict: evict nodes from GPU memory using priority-based heap eviction with write-back to host when needed
load_back: load evicted nodes back from host memory into GPU memory with quota-aware allocation and automatic fallback eviction
match_prefix: match a token sequence prefix against the radix tree and return device indices, last device node, and host hit length
